more.title: 'Dropping Parandur Airport is not change; it's an irreversible setback': MK Stalin, Annamalai question TVK govt over project cancellation
more.description: In a significant decision, Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister has called off the Parandur airport project, igniting a wave of reactions. While opposition leaders contend that this cancellation hinders the region's economic development, Congress lends their support, emphasizing the importance of addressing farmers' grievances and environmental sustainability. The next challenge for the government lies in selecting a new site for the proposed airport.

more.description: The era of reaping excessive profits purely by leveraging the "American brand label" has officially drawn to a full close.
